$description: Ivycoast Hub — machine-readable token layer. Three tiers: reference (raw values) → semantic (roles) → component (per-object). Mirrors index.html :root exactly. Edit a REFERENCE or SEMANTIC token and every object/page consuming it refines (the cascade). Spec target: DTCG 2025.10 (stable). Companion to DESIGN_SYSTEM.md — that doc holds the logic + reasons.

$meta.author: Jude (iris-design)
$meta.cascadeRule: Objects and layouts consume ONLY semantic tokens (never raw hex). Change a reference value → the semantic alias updates → every object updates → every page updates. To branch, alias a component token to a different semantic token; never hard-code a new hex in a component.
$meta.v2Refinements: 2026-07-13 (Jude): (P0) Closed the cmp cascade breaks — cmp.badge.padY→{ref.space.0-25}, cmp.seg.indicatorRadius→{ref.radius.seg}, cmp.helpTip.btnSize→{ref.size.chip}, cmp.drawer.overlayScrim→{ref.color.scrim}. Added ref primitives: space.0-25 (1px), size.chip (18px), radius.seg (10px), color.scrim (rgba(0,0,0,0.28)). Resolved drifts: ONE scrim opacity (0.28), ONE drawer width (~560px non-blocking), motion.drawer 300ms canonical (240 fallback is a leftover). Renamed cmp.navTab.style-size→styleSize. (P2) Hoisted group-level $type across the ref tier (DTCG 2025.10 inheritance) — leaves omit $type. sem composites (typeStyle/sell/eventTint) and cmp bare-alias maps are a DELIBERATE, scoped, annotated non-conformance (no build step consumes them). Every alias resolves to a real token.
$meta.v4Refinements: 2026-07-14 (Jude): Tokenized table (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4.18 upgraded from a thin entry to the full table object). Promoted cmp.table.* to a first-class object with two density variants that branch via ONE row-geometry token pair — rowH→{ref.control.lg}(~44) default, rowHCompact→{ref.control.md}(~38) compact; tune these two and every table in the app re-densifies (owner directive). Added cellPadY/cellPadYCompact (space.2-5 / space.2), cellPadX/cellPadXCompact (space.3 / space.1-5), headerBorder + divider (→borderSeparator), thStyle (→label, the TARGET) + thText (→textSecondary, the SHIPPED colour), tdSize (→size.md 14, CORRECTED from the old sm/12 that contradicted every live table), tdText, numFont (→font.mono for right-aligned tabular money cells), hoverBg (→surfaceSecondary, CORRECTED from the old hoverTint that no shipped table uses), selBg (→primaryTint, for the not-yet-shipped clickable-row selection state), hoverMotion (→duration.fast) + ease. NO new ref/sem primitives — row heights reuse the control-height scale (a row height is a hit-region axis, §2.4), every value aliases existing ref/sem. Row-height on control.* not space.* is deliberate (same rationale as inputs). No zebra token added — striping ships only on .formula-oils-table (a Formulator recipe table, not .ivh-table); tokenizing it would imply an app-wide stripe that doesn't exist. Values MEASURED from shipped .ivh-table / crm-stock-table / inv-line-items; three header/hover/size divergences logged as reconcile item #8 (index.html aligns to tokens; this pass does not touch index.html).
$meta.v3Refinements: 2026-07-14 (Jude): Panel & modal pattern family (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4.11). Added cmp.panel.* — THE side-panel object (docked reflow + overlay scrim variants, one mechanism). Promoted the record-panel width from the CRM one-off (--crm-panel-w) to cmp.panel.width min(540px,94vw). Added cmp.panel.widthChat (sanctioned Ivy-chat width branch, --ivy-dock-w), cmp.panel.scrim→{ref.color.scrim}, cmp.panel.motion→{ref.duration.drawer}, cmp.panel.motionScrim→{ref.duration.slow}. Added cmp.confirm.* (transactional confirm modal — the shipped showConfirm): width min(420px,92vw), radius→{ref.radius.2xl}, shadow→{ref.shadow.xl}, scrim→{ref.color.scrim}. Deprecated cmp.drawer.* ($deprecated:true) — now aliases cmp.panel.* so nothing breaks mid-migration (§7.8); consolidation target body.panel-open + .side-panel[data-mode] specced for the index.html pass (appendix drift #7). No new ref/sem primitives needed — every panel/confirm value aliases an existing ref/sem token except the three sanctioned width clamps.

ref.$description: TIER 1 — reference / primitive tokens. Raw, context-free values. The cascade ROOT. Do not consume these directly in a component; consume the semantic alias that points here.

color.$description: Group-level $type:'color' hoisted (DTCG 2025.10 group inheritance) — leaves omit $type and inherit it. Single-consumer hues (blue.500→stageProspect, yellow.500→stageOutreach, coral.500→stageNegotiation, ivy.label→sectionLabel) are the STAGE/LABEL palette: each is the reusable primitive for one closed-vocabulary role, not a general-purpose hue. Not pass-throughs (A3/D1).

scrim.$description: THE ONE modal/drawer overlay scrim. Resolves the two-opacity drift (0.28 Loop vs 0.32 person-drawer) — 0.28 is canonical. Only the blocking variant (narrow screen / destructive) uses it; the desktop record drawer is non-blocking (no scrim).

0-25.$description: quarter-step — hairline vertical inset for the badge (label-role text is 16px lh; 1px keeps the pill tight). Sanctioned sub-4 step, like the gutter.

gutter.$description: page horizontal gutter — off-grid by 4 on purpose; the one sanctioned non-multiple-of-4

chip.$description: smallest square affordance — helpTip '?' button, count-chip min-width. Two consumers, so it earns a primitive.

icon.$description: THE inline/control svg icon size (--size-icon). One icon language: SVG, stroke-width 1.7, sized by this token — never by width/height attributes. Added 2026-07-15 (header trio was 38px-fill / 20px / font-glyph).

seg.$description: seg sliding-indicator inner radius = seg outer (xl 12) minus the 2px track inset. A derived inner-radius step; sits between lg and xl. Named (not t-shirt) because it is a single geometric one-off, like space.gutter.

drawer.$description: canonical drawer duration. The person-drawer's 240ms fallback is a leftover — consume this token, remove the fallback (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md appendix #3, RESOLVED).

sem.$description: TIER 2 — semantic / system tokens. Roles, not raw values. THIS is the layer objects consume and the layer you EDIT to re-theme. Every alias references a ref.* token so a reference edit cascades.

primary.$description: brand, active state, primary button, links

primaryTint.$description: selected row/chip bg, callout-info, today cell

textTertiary.$description: >=4.69:1 on all text surfaces — AA. Labels only at 10px.

surfaceSecondary.$description: nested/subdued container: pipeline & make columns, search input

settleBg.$description: settled-money family; resolves SETTLE/TASK tint collision

sell.$description: Sell-pipeline stage identity (5 stages). Each = accent (header/left-bar/dot) + soft bg (column wash). A BRANCH of the semantic stage concept. DELIBERATE scoped DTCG non-conformance: modeled as an ad-hoc {accent,bg} object, not two typed color tokens per stage — more legible by hand, and we have no build tool consuming it. Closed vocabulary (5 stages), so it passes the two-consumer rule as a role-set. Formalize into typed tokens only if we ever add Style Dictionary / Tokens Studio.

eventTint.$description: Typed-event tint map (calendar + strip). Each type aliases a status/family. TASK now points to settle-distinct amber; MONEY red; CONTRACT ivy; LAUNCH green; MAKE indigo; SETTLE teal. DELIBERATE scoped DTCG non-conformance: ad-hoc {bg,text} objects rather than typed pairs — same rationale as sem.sell. Closed 8-type vocabulary; every leaf aliases a sem.color role so a status re-map cascades.

typeStyle.$description: Named text roles (5). Objects reference a role, never raw size+weight. Uppercase/mono is a DELIBERATE label accent — never body. DELIBERATE scoped DTCG non-conformance: these are typography composites but use bare keys (font/size/weight/leading/case) with alias strings, not the DTCG typography $type/$value shape, and `case` is not a DTCG typography sub-value. Kept hand-legible; conform to $type:'typography' only if a token build tool is introduced.

label.$description: section/column/field labels, badges, seg options, IDs, amounts

cmp.$description: TIER 3 — component tokens. Per-object knobs that reference semantic tokens. Branch an object by re-aliasing ITS component token to a different semantic token — no new hex, no structural fork. INVARIANT (audited): no raw literal (px/hex/duration/rgba) in any cmp token — every value is a {ref.*}/{sem.*}/{cmp.*} alias. The ONLY sanctioned literals are the three min()/max() width clamps — cmp.panel.width min(540px,94vw), cmp.panel.widthChat min(420px,max(320px,15vw)) (sanctioned width branch), and cmp.confirm.width min(420px,92vw) — each a true one-off with no reusable primitive (see their $widthNotes). DELIBERATE scoped DTCG non-conformance: cmp leaves are bare alias maps ({"bg":"{sem...}"}) without per-leaf $type/$value — legible by hand, no build tool consumes this tier. Conform (wrap each in $type/$value) only if a token pipeline is added.

cardSubdued.$description: BRANCH of card: nested container (stage-col/dev-col). Overrides bg+border+radius only.

fchip.$description: multi-select filter chip (aria-pressed) — distinct from seg (single-select tablist).

pcard.$description: BRANCH of card: board/pipeline card. Smaller radius, own hover-border.

panel.$description: THE side-panel pattern (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4.11.1–.2, family §4.11). ONE object, two data-modes: docked (reflow, non-blocking, no scrim — the record surface) and overlay (scrim, blocking, focus-trapped — <768px fallback / focus-capture). Consumed by every record surface (order/contact/invoice/product/person) and the Ivy chat dock (which branches width only, see widthChat). Consolidation target: body.panel-open + .side-panel[data-mode]. Supersedes cmp.drawer.* (deprecated below).
panel.$widthNote: SANCTIONED one-off literal — a min(px,vw) clamp has no reusable primitive; over-tokenizing a true one-off adds indirection with no payoff (A4/D3). This is THE canonical record-panel width, PROMOTED from the old CRM one-off (--crm-panel-w min(540px,94vw)) to the single panel token — every docked record surface reflows against it. The old person-drawer min(420px,92vw)+blocking variant is a leftover, RESOLVED to this spec (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md appendix #2).
panel.$widthChatNote: SANCTIONED width BRANCH (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4.11.5) — the Ivy chat dock (--ivy-dock-w) is a persistent, narrower companion, not a transient record panel. It rides the same body.panel-open + docked mechanism (reflow/scrim/motion) but aliases this width instead of cmp.panel.width. A token branch (§6.2), not a structural fork. Second sanctioned min()/max() clamp literal — same rationale as width.

confirm.$description: Transactional confirm modal (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4.11.3) — center, blocking, focus-trapped, promise-based (the shipped showConfirm). Reserved for irreversible/destructive actions (generate-settlement, delete). NOT a record surface (those are cmp.panel). A modal is not a side panel, so it is its own object.
confirm.$widthNote: SANCTIONED one-off literal — center confirm-dialog width clamp, no reusable primitive (same rationale as cmp.panel.width). Narrower than the record panel: a confirm holds one question + two buttons, not a scrollable record.

drawer.$description: DEPRECATED (2026-07-14) → use cmp.panel.* (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4.11 pattern family, appendix drift #7). Kept resolving during migration (§7.8): re-point every consumer to cmp.panel.*, then delete. width→cmp.panel.width, overlayScrim→cmp.panel.scrim, motion→cmp.panel.motion, overlayMotion→cmp.panel.motionScrim.

helpTip.$description: page-header '?' — progressive disclosure. Replaces always-on subtitle.

emptyState.$description: NEEDS UPGRADE — current impl is centered text only; target = heading + guidance + primary action (Polaris anatomy). See DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §7 gap.

table.$description: THE tokenized table object (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4.18). ONE object, two density variants (default + compact) that branch via a single row-geometry token pair. Consumed by every tabular surface — .ivh-table (docs / invoice-list / orders / products / customers / batch-history) at default density; the crm-stock-table + inv-line-items at compact density. Tune rowH / cellPad here and every table in the app re-densifies (the owner's directive, 2026-07-14). VALUES MEASURED FROM SHIPPED .ivh-table, not invented — thText is text-tab/textSecondary (the shipped header treatment), NOT the label role; tdSize is text-md (14), NOT bodySmall. Where the shipped table diverges from this spec (header letter-spacing 0.5px, hover=surfaceSecondary not hoverTint), the token encodes the AGREED target and the divergence is logged as a reconcile item in §4.18 / the appendix — the index.html pass aligns to these tokens, this pass does not touch index.html.
table.$rowHNote: Default body-row height ~44px (10px+10px pad over a 20px line = ~40px content box; control.lg=44 is the nearest named hit-region step and the comfortable-scan target). A ROW HEIGHT is a hit-region axis, not a spacing value — it belongs on the control-height scale, same rationale as inputs/buttons (§2.4). rowHCompact branches this to control.md; changing these two re-densifies the whole app.
table.$rowHCompactNote: Compact body-row height ~38px — measured from crm-stock-table / inv-line-items (8px+8px pad ≈ 34px content; control.md=38 is the nearest named step). THE density branch: a table opts into compact by aliasing rowH→rowHCompact (§4.18 branch recipe). One token flips a dense table.
table.$headerBorderNote: header→body rule. Shipped .ivh-table th uses a 2px borderSeparator underline (heavier than the 1px row divider) to seat the header; the compact table uses 1px borderLight. Border WEIGHT is not a color token — the 2px vs 1px distinction is a structural rule stated in §4.18, both weights resolve to a border color here.
table.$thStyleNote: TARGET header type role = label (mono/10/uppercase/-0.3px), matching the doc's single-strongest-signature rule (§2.2) and the ALREADY-compliant inv-line-items / formula-oils / crm-stock headers. SHIPPED .ivh-table th diverges (text-tab 13 / display / textSecondary / letter-spacing 0.5px) — reconcile item #8. thText below encodes the shipped header colour so the token layer is honest about today; align to thStyle in the index.html pass.
table.$thTextNote: Shipped .ivh-table header colour (textSecondary). The compact tables already use textTertiary (the label-role colour). Target on reconcile is textTertiary via thStyle; kept as its own token so a header re-tint is one edit.
table.$tdSizeNote: Shipped .ivh-table cell size = text-md (14), NOT bodySmall(12). The old cmp.table.tdSize said sm(12) — that contradicted every live table and is corrected here to the measured value (reconcile item #8). Compact tables (crm-stock: text-md td) also read at 14; inv-line-items at 14 — 14 is the app-wide cell size.
table.$numFontNote: money/numeric cells (.num-cell) render mono + tabular-nums + right-aligned so digits column-align for scanning (§4.18 column-type contract). Aliases the mono family; the tabular-nums + right-align are structural rules in §4.18, not tokenizable values.
table.$hoverBgNote: SHIPPED row-hover fill = surfaceSecondary (.ivh-table tr:hover td, products/orders/batch all match). The old cmp.table.rowHover pointed at hoverTint — that contradicted every live table (hoverTint is the neutral LIST-ROW hover, §4.8; tables shipped with the stronger surfaceSecondary wash). Corrected to the measured value; if the two should unify, that's reconcile item #8, decided in the index.html pass — not silently flipped here.
table.$selBgNote: selected-row fill — aliases the app-wide selected surface (primaryTint), same as listRow.selBg. No table ships a selected-row state today; this is the sanctioned value for when one is added (clickable rows that open a docked record panel), so it matches selection everywhere else rather than inventing a tint.
